title: 核心缺陷定位与修复：链级无关性证明（闭环池解析 + 内核准入判决发布）
scope: chain-agnostic core defects proven on BOTH chains (4663 mainnet / 46630 testnet)

core_defects_fixed.title: 闭环池解析仅查锚点作用域面，共享桥接池被整体丢弃

mainnet_4663.note: bridge (hop_index=2) pools are shared across anchors; the anchor scoped candidate/observation surfaces record them under only the anchor that discovered them

core_defects_fixed.root_cause: market_observation_core.db_closed_loop_sequences._anchor_candidate_pool() returned None for any pool absent from the anchor scoped candidate/observation surfaces; the hop was then skipped, so len(route_rows) != 3 discarded EVERY sequence.

fix.change: fall back to the chain scoped v4_exchange_pools / v4_exchange_pool_liquidity_snapshots when the pool is absent from the anchor scoped surfaces

core_defects_fixed.title: Rust 内核准入判决未发布到链级流动性快照表，链级读取方一律判为覆盖缺口

testnet_46630.note: identical defect: the verdict was published on the anchor scoped candidate surface only

core_defects_fixed.root_cause: has_confirmed_depth() consumes the kernel verdict (kernelAdmitted) published by the Rust kernel. business_builder.rs published it on dex_candidate_pools.depth_band_json only, so every pool read from the chain scoped exchange tables had reason 'kernel_verdict_missing' and was never admitted.

fix.change: attach_kernel_admission_verdict() publishes kernelAdmitted/kernelAdmissionReason/kernelDepthBand onto the chain scoped liquidity snapshot depth document
shared admit_candidate_pool_with_liquidity() reads the shared depth policy
depth_band_json_with_admission() publishes the verdict on both the candidate surface and the chain scoped snapshot

core_vs_chain_separation.rule: system data and the processing pipeline are separated; the pipeline must not depend on a concrete chain
core_vs_chain_separation.method: the same core code path and the same defect signature was reproduced on BOTH chains before the fix, and the same fix was applied once in chain agnostic code

testnet_46630.residual_blocker: chain DATA condition: 8 of 16 loop pools are measured dust/shallow, not a pipeline defect
testnet_46630.evidence: all 38 testnet loops are blocked by at least one pool whose kernel reason is depth_verdict_rejected:dust / :shallow

mainnet.write_performed: pool-manager depth --scope all --apply (21 pools refreshed with the kernel verdict)

testnet.write_performed: pool-manager depth --scope all --apply (25 pools refreshed with the kernel verdict)

not_yet_achieved: no production arbitrage broadcast transaction has been produced yet
the stability criterion (STABILITY_REQUIRED_WINDOWS=3 / STABILITY_MIN_WINDOW_SECONDS=1800, blockers==[], missingValue==0, positive>0) is still unmet
the mainnet review repair gate (manager_v4_reviews payload_json.loop_key empty) is still open
